# activity-frames

> Deterministic compiler from locally-captured screen activity (SQLite) to agent memory:
> typed activity frames, compact context blocks, and replayable click-by-click scripts.
> No LLM in the compile path; byte-identical output; local-only; MIT.

## Install
pip install activity-frames            # zero dependencies, py3.9+
pip install "activity-frames[yaml]"    # optional YAML output

## CLI (entry point: aframes)
aframes record            # start/stop local capture engine (macOS)
aframes today | day DATE  # structured frames (YAML/JSON/md)
aframes context --hours N # compact agent context block
aframes apps              # per-app time ledger
aframes patterns --days N # repetitive workflow detection
aframes comms --hours N   # email/messaging surfaces + titles
aframes steps --frame ID | --find "task query"   # replay-view script
aframes mcp               # MCP stdio server

## MCP (6 tools)
get_context, get_activity, get_steps, get_day_summary, get_patterns, get_communications
Register: claude mcp add activity-frames -- aframes mcp

## Python API
from activity_frames import ActivityLog
ActivityLog().day() / .recent(hours=N) / .context(hours=N)
Also exported: Database, find_default_db, segments, app_ledger, coverage,
context_block, to_json, to_yaml, to_markdown, parse_url, detect_patterns, comm_surfaces

## Data source
Local capture DB (default engine provisioned by `aframes record`; hash-verified).
Bring your own recorder: set $AFRAMES_DB to any DB with frames/ui_events/elements tables.

## Docs
AGENTS.md - integration guide for AI agents
SPEC.md - schema contract (measured vs inferred)
docs/mcp.md, docs/python.md, docs/cli.md, docs/troubleshooting.md
